events.title: October Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in and around Old Fort. Gateway trails do not allow e-bikes. Foothills Watershed allows e-bikes. Post-ride social at Foothills Watershed. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite.

events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on maintenance clinic with Daily Cycle AVL covering skipping shifting, chain issues, rubbing brakes, and valve core problems. Rain or shine event. Dress in clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Bring your trail tools/kit. Check in 4:30-5pm. Drink token and small snack provided.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune with Cane Creek Components. For riders comfortable on downhill trails with rocks and roots. Ride the same loop and dial in suspension with experts. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Bring snacks and water. Location does not allow e-bikes. Please allow other riders if you've done a test + tune before. Cane Creek handling registration with 8 spots available.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Neither location allows e-bikes. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery, 342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Location does not allow e-bikes. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing, 25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231. All riders must sign up through Eventbrite.
